Name: Besheth, Guardian Deva
Information:
**Besheth, Guardian Deva**

Besheth, formerly a deva of Harros, was summoned into the deserts of Greyrock in an ancient age to pass judgement upon a fiend-possessed king who was abusing and mistreating their people. This king, the King of Bloodied Sand, was working their people to death, and sacrificing those who were too exhausted to work to a demon who granted it power and demonic magic. Besheth materialized in response to the people’s call for liberation, and initially disguised themselves as a human who investigated the wrong-doings of the King, eventually unveiling the true source of their power.

Upon realizing the Abyss’s influence, Besheth unveiled their true form and fought back against the king, only to find themselves overtaken by the cabal of nefarious arcanists and fiendish subordinates they had to face. Despite their radiant might, Besheth alone could not serve to liberate this land, and for a time was sealed away, beaten to the point of constant exhaustion, and strung up on public display as a warning to those who would challenge the king.

**The People’s Hand**

Among the people who watched on helplessly, one heroic warrior - a young woman named Tyrest - would take up the discarded holy weapon Besheth dropped during their conflict, and led a rebellion to free the deva, and in spite of great losses they managed to save the angel and restore them to good health. With the aid of the people backing them up to keep the king’s forces at bay, Besheth once again battled the demon who had enslaved this land, and overcame it by conjuring a hurricane of radiant power, which buried everything the king had built.

Besheth remained among mankind for a time, making sure everything left behind by the demons was washed clean, with Tyrest serving as their mortal aid. Once a generation had passed and the people had reclaimed their destiny, Besheth considered their role to be complete.

**Reassignment**

Having completed their duty, the deva aimed to return to the Heavens, but would later ask to have their celestial duties changed so they could be put in charge of the desert kingdoms of Greyrock. Though civilization in Greyrock has dwindled over the generations, Besheth’s influence remains, aiding and watching over those who become lost in the endless sands. Some still seek out the desert and attempt to commune with the deva to gain their favor and wisdom.

traits.name: Concealing Winds
traits.description: Winds roar around Besheth, granting all ranged attacks against them disadvantage. Additionally, no effect can move Besheth against their will as long as they aren’t incapacitated.

traits.name: Divine Judgement
traits.description: When speaking with a mortal creature, Besheth can divine the crimes committed during their life and the context surrounding them, which the deva knows with great familiarity.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: Besheth’s spellcasting ability is Charisma. They can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

traits.name: Wind Chain Mastery
traits.description: When Besheth makes a melee weapon attack, they can treat that weapon’s reach as 30 feet.

actions.name: Radiant Tyrest’s Coil
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Gold Feather Judgement (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Besheth unleashes a flurry of golden slashes and intense winds that strike everything within 30 feet of it, forcing each creature within that Besheth chooses to make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. Each creature who fails takes 5d10 radiant damage and 5d10 force damage, or half as much damage on a success. Then, Besheth can move any creature who failed into another unoccupied space of their choice within this action’s range, where they fall prone.

bonus_actions.name: Angelic Sanctity (2/Rest)
bonus_actions.description: Besheth touches one creature, who regains 70 hit points, and is cured of any condition or effect that could be removed by greater restoration, as well as all Combat Fatigue.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: Besheth magically transforms into a humanoid of any description, a beast of a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back to its true form. If it dies it reverts to its true form. In any humanoid form its statistics remain the same, but in the form of a beast it assumes the AC, movement speed(s), Strength, Dexterity, senses, attacks, and actions of that beast (except class features, Legendary Actions, and Lair Actions) but retains access to its own actions and senses as well.

options.name: Move
options.description: Besheth moves up to half their movement speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

options.name: Spellcast (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: Besheth casts one spell using Innate Spellcasting with a casting time of 1 action.

options.name: Divine Hurricane (Costs 3 Actions)
options.description: Until the end of Besheth’s next turn, hurricane winds carrying sand and ash fill a 50-foot radius sphere centered on Besheth. All creatures within are invisible to one another unless they have tremorsense or a nonvisual means to detect one another. Creatures with tremorsense can treat this hurricane as though it was the ground, and detect other creatures through it.
